name: Harbour Town Center (Jalan Soekarno-Hatta)
tagline: The walkable heart along the waterfront
description: The main strip hugging the harbour on Jalan Soekarno-Hatta, packed with dive shops, tour operators, warungs, cafes, and the ports where boats depart. It is the most convenient base for booking trips, eating out, and getting connected, with everything a short walk away.
bestFor: First-timers, divers, and anyone wanting everything within walking distance
pros: Easy access to boats and dive shops

name: Hillside Sunset-Bar Area
tagline: Elevated views over the island-dotted bay
description: The slopes just above the town center, home to the famous hillside sunset bars and boutique stays looking out over the bay and its scattered islands. Quieter and cooler than the harbour, it trades convenience for some of the best evening views anywhere in Labuan Bajo.
pros: Cooler and calmer than the harbour
Nice bars and cafes close by

name: Waecicu / Pantai Pede (Road South to the Beaches)
tagline: Beaches and resorts a short ride from town
description: The coast just south and northwest of the center around Pantai Pede and Waecicu, where beaches, dive resorts, and quieter accommodation sit close to the water. It offers a more relaxed, resort-style base within easy reach of the harbour by scooter or Gojek.
bestFor: Slow travellers and divers wanting calm near the beach
pros: Close to beaches and dive resorts

name: Seraya Island
tagline: An offshore island escape near Komodo
description: A small island north of Labuan Bajo with simple bungalow stays, clear snorkelling right off the beach, and a genuinely off-grid feel. Reached by boat from the harbour, it suits travellers wanting an island base close to the national park rather than town convenience.
pros: True island escape near the park
